howto.intro: Each guide covers one task in 5 to 10 steps. The labels are the ones on the screens. Guides for your own role are listed first. The Agent Operator uses "Agents", "Intake agent", "Adjudication agent" and "Agent runs" to prepare work, reaches the "Steward assistant" from "Agents" and the "Intake queue" from "More tools". A person still makes permit decisions.

guides.title: Run the agents
guides.summary: Wake an agent, process the cases that wait, read what it did and put it back to sleep.
steps: Open "Agents" in the left menu. The counts read "Waiting", "Running" and "Failed". Under "Agent status" each agent reads asleep or awake.

Click "Intake agent" in the left menu or under "Agent status". Open "More details" to read "Processing" and "Engine". While the agent is asleep the page says "The agent is asleep, so the run buttons are off." Process one and Process the next 20 cases stay off until you wake it.
Click "Wake agent". The button now reads "Put agent to sleep". A woken agent stays awake until a person puts it back to sleep.

Under "Waiting work" click "Process one" on a case, or press Process the next 20 cases. Read the message at the top. To work a selection of the cases that arrived, open "More tools" in the left menu, then "Intake queue", select the cases and press "Process selected with agent".
Read "Needs attention" for work that failed, and click "Try again" on a row to run it again. "Recent results" is under "More details".

For the Adjudication agent do the same on its own screen. The recommendations it makes appear under "Waiting for a person". Only a person decides. On the hosted demonstration live Muse is on, with a daily allowance of 100 calls. When live Muse is off, or that allowance is used up, recorded answers are used and the screen says so.

On "Agents", under "Agent status", click "Steward assistant" and click "Wake agent" so the Data Steward can press "Prepare recommendations". It works only when the steward asks. Its counts read "High", "Review" and "Held".
Open "Agent runs" in the left menu. Narrow the list with "Agent" and "State". Open "More filters" for "Processing mode" and "Date", then click "Apply filters". Click "Clear filters" to start again.

Click "View run" on a row to open "Run detail". Read "Processing mode", "Processing steps" and "Recorded business changes". A failed run offers "Retry", which needs the agent to be awake. On the agent screen, "All runs", "Processing" and "Engine" are under "More details".
When you have finished, go back to each agent and click "Put agent to sleep". Leave "Steward assistant" awake if a Data Steward still needs it.
guides.result: The waiting cases are prepared for a person, and every run is recorded in Agent runs. A run records preparation only: a person makes every permit decision.
